payload.posture: Read Acts 7:43–60 as evidence about the Temple, keeping its action, claim, context, and limits distinct.
payload.tension: The passage states wilderness testimony, David, Solomon, prophetic quotation, accusation, death, and witness form the speech’s close. It does not by itself supply every cause or later interpretation of this part of the Temple.
